description:
Bulk-import a CSV file into a D365 F&O entity through the Data Management
package REST API. Builds the package (Manifest + header + CSV) in memory,
uploads it to Azure blob, then calls ImportFromPackage which AUTO-CREATES the
data project from the manifest. Runs in batch; the tool polls until completion
and returns the final status plus an error-keys file URL when rows fail.
Provide either filePath (a .csv on disk) or inline csvContent. Resolve the
entity name from the KB (find_entity_for_table) -- do not invent it.

csvContent.description: Inline CSV content (header row + data). Provide this OR filePath.

definitionGroupId.description: DMF definition group (data project) id. Default: auto-generated from entity + timestamp.

entityName.description: Target entity name as known to DMF (the entity, not the OData set), e.g. 'Customers V3'.

execute.description: Execute the import after staging (true) or stage only (false). Default true.

filePath.description: Path to a .csv file on disk. Provide this OR csvContent.

legalEntity.description: Legal entity / company id to import into, e.g. 'USMF'.

overwrite.description: Overwrite an existing project definition with the same id. Default true.

pollTimeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to poll for completion before returning the executionId. Default 300.

name: dmf_import_file
